sql: SELECT Name, Age FROM Users WHERE Age > 18 ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Role, COUNT(*) AS Cnt FROM Users WHERE Age >= 18 GROUP BY Role HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY Cnt DESC

desc: Kéttáblás LEFT JOIN szűréssel, rendezéssel, lapozással
sql: SELECT u.Name, o.Item FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Orders o ON u.Id = o.Owner WHERE u.Age >= 25 ORDER BY u.Name DESC LIMIT 4

desc: CASE WHEN és korrelált EXISTS allekérdezés
sql: SELECT Name, CASE WHEN Age > 40 THEN 'Senior' WHEN Age > 25 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'Junior' END AS Level FROM Users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.Owner = u.Id) ORDER BY Name ASC

desc: Háromtáblás JOIN összetett feltétellel, LIKE, rendezés, LIMIT és OFFSET
sql: SELECT u.Name, o.Item, p.Title FROM Users u JOIN Orders o ON u.Id = o.Owner JOIN Products p ON o.Id = p.Parent WHERE u.Name LIKE 'B%' AND (o.Qty >= 1 OR p.Price < 20) ORDER BY p.Price DESC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 1
